answer: Locked capital in a 60-day unbonding window is the scarce resource: each identity locks 90 units, released at the window close. At genesis it publishes a signed statement embedding a unique pearl nonce into the tundra archive, a record fixed for the window. Any verifier can replay that archive and prove one pearl, key, or signature was reused by two identities; a verified proof cuts both weights to their nadir, zero, and slashes both locks. Splitting one pool leaves each below 90, so capital cannot be pooled. An honest agent locks 90 once and recovers it; 1,000 fakes must lock 90,000 units.
